name: Guardian Standard of Recovery heals the amount its buff advertises, including Strength scaling (#6604, #8369)
contract: Standard of Recovery 500260 summons creature 50053, which casts 500266 on itself: an APPLY_AREA_AURA_FRIEND whose effect 0 is aura 23 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL with Amplitude 3000, triggering the direct heal 500248. The buff's own tooltip (Spell.dbc column 187) reads 'A nearby Standard of Recovery is causing you to regenerate ${$w1+$STR*.25} health every $t1 sec', and the cast tooltip ($500248m1+$500248ppl1+$STR*.25) bills the same base, so the aura's $w1 base must be the triggered heal's own 1, not a flat 80 that made a level-2 standard heal about 70 per tick (#8369). Effect 1 is the '+$s2% healing received' half, aura 319 with BasePoints 5. The tick is script-driven: aura_ascension_guardian_recovery::Tick prevents the native trigger and re-casts 500248 with the aura's amount plus 0.25 x the owner's Strength. This scenario pins the contract at level 1: the owner's Strength must read 27, the aura's effect 0 amount must read 1, and one tick must land at (1 + floor(0.25 x 27)) x the buff's own +6% healing received = 7.

steps.label: SETUP: the starter Hearthstone satisfies 500260's TotemCategory 5
The Standard of Recovery banner summons
The owner carries the Standard's periodic buff
CONTRACT: the buff's advertised $w1 base is the triggered heal's own 1, not the flat 80 that ignored level scaling
SETUP: the owner's Strength is the fixed 27 the tooltip's $STR term multiplies by 0.25, so the tick's amount is determinate
Fixture a low health inside a large pool so the tick is never overhealed
One tick heals (1 + floor(0.25 x 27)) x the buff's own +6% = 7; the band admits that tick and rejects the previous flat-80 tick at 84
The heal lands through the native heal log
